root_cause_review.lambda_captures: Upstream IO and Flight callbacks use [=] while accessing members, implicitly capturing this. C++20 supports but deprecates this spelling. No capture or callback lifetime changes are proposed.
root_cause_review.compatibility_options: Generated bindings retain Arrow 25 deprecated SortOptions, RankOptions and Ordering overloads for the Python legacy null_placement argument. Current sort-key APIs and exact legacy FutureWarning behavior are tested without filters.
root_cause_review.timezone_option: Python set_timezone_db_path writes Arrow GlobalOptions.timezone_db_path, deprecated since Arrow 24 and retained for Windows compatibility. GCC emits the same field diagnostic three times.
